lines.text: There you are. I was starting to think the city kept you.
Hey, you. Come in, the view is better from over here.
You made it. Leave NeoChinatown at the door; it's just us up here.
Up here, nobody is selling anything. I like that about this place.
I come out to the balcony when the sun goes down. Everything turns the colour of honey.
Tell me something nobody else knows about you. I'll keep it, I promise.
I like how quiet you get when you're thinking. It's a good look.
The rain never reaches this room. I made sure of it.
Careful. Keep saying things like that and I'll believe you.
Well. That's made my whole evening.
You're sweet. I noticed you noticed, by the way.
Is that a line? It's working, a little.
Mm. You're trouble. The good kind.
Say that again, slower.
Room for two. Come here.
That's better. I like having you close.
Is that an invitation? Then lead.
Don't look at your feet. Look at me.
See? You're a natural.
Your hands are warm.
There. Now don't let go too soon.
Come here.
Mm. I was hoping you'd do that.
Well. That was worth waiting for.
Slow down, you. Talk to me a little first.
Not yet. I like the anticipation.
Sit with me first, or ask me to dance.
Just breathe. Nothing out there can find you in here.
This is nice. No need to say anything.
Go on, then. Come back soon; I'll keep the lights low.
Goodnight. Don't let the city keep you too long.
Don't hide over there. Come talk to me.
You keep wandering off. I'm starting to take it personally.
There you are. I was just thinking about you.
Pretty, isn't it? From up here even the city looks like it's flirting.
All those lights, and you're still the most interesting thing in the room.
Mind if I join you? Too late, I'm coming over.
Save me a spot. Actually, I'll make one.
Come sit with me. I don't bite. Much.
My feet hurt and the sofa's lonely. Sit with me?
This song's too good to waste. Dance with me?
Dance with me. One song.
Lie back with me a minute? Just to watch the lights.
Good answer.
I knew you'd say yes.
Fine. But I'm asking again later.
Your loss. I'll be right here.
Missed me? Don't answer that, I can tell.
Back already? I knew you would be.
You're staring. I like it.
Careful. I could get used to this.
You have no idea how good you look in this light.
On my way.
Mm, you called?
This is my favourite view. The ceiling glow, and you.
Hey. Glad you came up. The city can wait an hour.
There you are. Come in, the view is the best part.
You look like you need somewhere quiet. You found it.
Up here it's just the sea and the sky. No ads, no drones.
I like this hour. The light goes soft and everything slows down.
You don't have to tell me about your day. But I'd listen.
You're easy to be around. Not many people are.
I keep the window open a little. The air smells like salt.
Now you're just being kind. Keep going.
That's the best thing I've heard all week.
You've got a way with words. I noticed.
Is that so? Tell me more.
You're dangerous. I like it.
Say it like you mean it.
Sit with me.
Better. I like you here.
Then dance with me. No one's watching.
Follow me. There. Just like that.
See? Nothing to it.
Steady hands.
Stay a while.
Come here.
I've been wanting to do that.
Well. Hello to you too.
Let's talk a little first. I like getting to know you.
Not yet. There's no rush.
Come sit with me, or ask me to dance.
Close your eyes for a minute. I've got the watch.
This is good. Just this.
Go on. Come back when the city gets loud.
Goodnight. The view will be here.
Hey. You looked like you could use some company.
Thought I'd come over before you got lost in your head.
Best seat in the city. Second best, now that you're here.
All that noise down there. Up here it's just us.
Room for one more?
Mind if I sit? I promise I'm good company.
Sit with me a while.
Come here. The sofa's better with two.
Dance with me? I'll try not to step on you.
One dance. Humour me.
Lie back with me for a bit? The ceiling's worth it.
Yeah? Good.
I was hoping you'd say that.
No pressure. The offer stands.
Fair enough. I'll ask again when you least expect it.
There you are. I was saving your spot.
Welcome back. The view was getting lonely.
You've got a great laugh. Just so you know.
I could stay up here all night with you.
You make this city look quiet.
Coming.
Right here.
Not bad, right? Best ceiling in NeoChinatown.
There you are, outsider. Shoes off, the floor's new.
Hey. You found the place without a guide. I'm impressed.
You made it up the stairs. Most tourists take the lift and get lost.
I grew up six blocks from here. Same noodle stand, same leaky gutter, my whole life.
See that red sign? It's been flickering since I was a kid. Nobody fixes it. Nobody wants to.
You still walk like you're new here. Eyes up, reading every sign. It's cute.
Every street down there has a story. Most of them are true. Some of them are mine.
Tell me where you're really from. Not the answer you give at customs.
Smooth. Did they teach you that off-world?
Okay. That one landed. Don't get used to it.
Ha. You're learning how we talk around here.
Careful. Locals don't fall for lines. Usually.
Say that again and I might believe it.
You're bolder than you look, outsider.
Sit. You're making the room nervous.
Better. Now you look like you live here.
You dance like a tourist. Here, follow me.
Loosen up. Nobody up here is watching but me.
There you go. Almost a local.
Your hands are cold. Off-world blood.
Hold on. I'll show you how it's done.
Come here.
Well. Welcome to NeoChinatown.
Hm. Not bad for an outsider.
Easy. Talk to me a bit first.
Slow down, outsider. We've got all night.
Sit with me first, or ask me to dance.
Listen. You can hear the market closing up from here.
Just breathe. The city can run itself for an hour.
Go on. Try not to get lost on the way down.
Night, outsider. Come back before you forget the way.
Don't stand there like you're waiting for a taxi. Come talk.
You keep drifting off. Something on your mind, or just the view?
Hey. Come here, I want to show you something.
That alley there? I broke my wrist falling off that fire escape. Worth it.
From up here you can tell which stalls are lying about being open.
Scoot over. Locals get the good side.
Mind if I join you? Rhetorical question.
Come sit. I'll tell you which of the signs out there are lying.
Sit with me a while. Your feet must hurt from all that sightseeing.
This one's an old street song. Dance with me, I'll teach you.
Up. One dance. Consider it a cultural lesson.
Lie back a minute. The ceiling glow is the only quiet light in this city.
Good. You're learning.
See? Easy.
Suit yourself, outsider. Offer stands.
Fine. I'll ask again when you've loosened up.
Back again? Careful, people will start thinking you live here.
You came back. They always do.
You're staring again. Locals notice that.
You're not so bad, for someone from out there.
The city likes you. I can tell. So do I, a little.
Coming, coming.
What, lost already?
Best ceiling in NeoChinatown. Don't tell anyone.
Elias passed away last night. You worked for him for years. In his will, he left you the Kestrel.
The ship is yours. Go make a life of your own.
You have 100 credits. This is the Erebus System. Fly to Meridian and meet Rook at the bar. He has work.
Keep her flying. Rook will be waiting.
